verdicts.verify_by: cp tests/b3-lines-reach-catalog-paged-mismatch-unlogged_test.go gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/feature/store/zz_b3_paged_unlogged_test.go && go test -count=1 -run TestB3PagedMismatchIsNotLogged -v ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/feature/store/: expect a log line naming 'answered', observe only the control's decode failure
verdicts.tldr: a realm page answer for the wrong key, page or page count makes the category or list page fall back to markdown with no log line, so the operator cannot see why
verdicts.details: decode's deferred Warn (api.go:146-148) only sees errors decode itself returns; paged builds the 'answered' error at api.go:208 after decode returned nil, cached() (cache.go:64-65) stores it without logging, and servePage (handler.go:143-145) returns nil under the comment 'an error is logged once by decode'. The only Logger calls in the package are api.go:147 Warn and listing.go:69 Debug, so the mismatch is never logged and repeats silently every 5 s cache window. The package is new in this diff, so the behaviour is introduced here. Fix: log the mismatch in paged before returning it (or run the echo check inside decode's deferred scope, e.g. as part of a check() the decode path calls), so every failure the page drops has one Warn.

verdicts.verify_by: gno test . -run TestActivityFloodedByServices -v in examples/gno.land/r/gnoland/store/v0 with the repro copied in: expect activity to still start with feed-app, observe []. Fix to check: push to activity only when l.shownApp(), keeping pulseListed.add on indexed()
verdicts.tldr: twenty service or package listings after the last app event empty the home activity feed, although newer app events exist
verdicts.details: track (pulse.gno:55-63) gates on l.indexed(), which is '!l.hidden && l.Confirmed' (listing.gno:268-270) and admits every kind, then pushes into the fixed 20-slot ring; writeActivity (api.gno:185-194) serves only events whose listing passes shownApp(), 'l.indexed() && l.Kind == kindApp'. So each toolbox listing takes a ring slot the feed can never serve, and activitySize (20) budgets room only for hidden or re-kinded listings. Once 16 or more non-app events follow the newest app events the feed shows fewer than 5, and at 20 it shows none; the realm is new in this diff. Fix: push to activity only when l.shownApp(), keeping pulseListed.add on indexed().

verdicts.verify_by: gno test . -run TestTrendingSlotOrderHidesHotApp -v (expect hotslot-app first, observe absent) then, alone, -run TestTrendingSlotOrderControl (same data, slots swapped: PASS). Fix to check: merge the seven descending slot iterators by bound, or give each slot its own share of trendingScan
verdicts.tldr: once 200 apps with 2+ ranked stars sit in one trend slot, Trending drops the week's top app whenever its slot comes later in the array, so which app leads depends on the day it was starred, not on its stars
verdicts.details: trending (shelves.gno:143-164) walks appTrend.slots in array index order and shares one trendingScan (200) budget; entries whose bound equals the n-th best score are not pruned since the test is 'bound < best.scores[best.n-1]', so 200 tied 2-star entries in slot 0 exhaust the scan and the loop breaks before slot 6 is read. The doc comment allows trendingScan to cut the result short but not that the cut falls by slot index rather than score: the same data with the slots swapped puts the 5-star app first. Reach needs 200 apps at 2+ ranked stars filed in one epoch, which free address namespaces make cheap to arrange. Fix: merge the seven descending slot iterators by bound (or give each live slot its own share of trendingScan), so the scan reads the highest bounds first whatever the slot.
